constructor.details: Constructor to initialize the liquidity migrator with the necessary contracts and addresses.

params._nonfungiblePositionManager: The address of the NonfungiblePositionManager contract (see Aerodrome Concentrated Liquidity periphery).
params.bondingCurvesStorage: The address of the bonding curves storage contract.
params.feeAccount: The address of the fee account that will receive fees.
params.liquidityLocker: The address of the liquidity locker contract.
params.poolFactory: The address of the Aerodrome Concentrated Liquidity factory contract.
params.wethAdress: The address of the WETH contract.

createPoolAndLockLiquidity(address,uint2.details: The pool is created with a fixed tick spacing, that is stored in this contract. Call tickSpacing() to get the current value (e.g. 2000 = 1%). 1% is the maximum fee tier supported. Check the Aerodrome Concentrated Liquidity Pool documentation for more details on fee tiers and tick spacing.This function can be called only by the bonding curve of the respective token.

params.amountToAdd: The amount of the token to add to the pool.
params.token: The address of the token to be added in the pair.

returns.amount0: The amount of the first token added to the pool.
returns.amount1: The amount of the second token added to the pool.
returns.liquidity: The amount of liquidity for this position.
returns.locker: The Locker created for the liquidity (See ICLLocker for more details).
returns.tokenId: The NFT ID of the created pool liquidity position.

getBondingCurveStorage().details: The BondingCurveStorage contract is a central contract that holds all the bonding curves and related data.

returns._0: The address of the BondingCurveStorage contract.

getFeeAccount().details: The FeeAccount contract is responsible for managing the fees collected from the Aerodrome Concentrated Liquidity pools and the bonding curves.

returns._0: The address of the FeeAccount contract.

getLiquidityLocker().details: The licquidity locker contract is used to lock liquidity and eventually migrate it to Aerodrome concentrated liquidity locker. See ICLLockerFactory for more details.

returns._0: The address of the liquidity locker contract.

getWeth().details: The WETH contract is used to wrap and unwrap Ether for liquidity operations.

getWethAddress().details: The WETH address is used to wrap and unwrap Ether for liquidity operations.

returns._0: The address of the WETH contract.

nonfungiblePositionManager().details: The NonfungiblePositionManager contract is used to manage the liquidity positions in Aerodrome Concentrated Liquidity pools.

returns._0: The instance of the NonfungiblePositionManager contract.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

createPoolAndLockLiquidity(address,uint2.notice: Creates a new Aerodrome Concentrated Liquidity pool for the specified token (token/WETH pair) and token amount.
